purpose: Attribute and simplify the finance predictor and its external learning loop; this is a mechanism comparison, not an empirical reproduction or novelty finding.

selection.criterion: The complete candidate generation, inexpensive critique, real-data evaluation, and retained feedback loop, rather than similarity of trading-agent names.
selection.boundary: These are different comparisons. No inspected source establishes all Zenith contracts or empirical performance.

zenith_comparison.task: Three admitted stocks, exact next-US-session close point forecasts; a declared compact replacement executed by the same native GodModeEngine and CP1/CP2 validators.
zenith_comparison.objective: Per-target absolute price error divided by the resolved target price; mean across targets within each issue, then equal issue weight. This is not portfolio return, profitability, calibration, or causal attribution.
zenith_comparison.learning: Frozen development evidence and bounded verified traces inform a reviewed single-field candidate. A new frozen comparison and separately sealed holdout evaluate it; there is no automatic gradient, topology optimizer, or live mutation.
zenith_comparison.empirical_boundary: No predictive improvement is asserted here. Compatibility failures and a transport halt are not completed forecast-accuracy evidence. Study outcomes and model revisions belong to their receipts.

paper_evaluation.boundary: The cited method is factor-code search, not exact-close forecasting or differentiable training. The inspected main experimental sections do not establish Zenith-style immutable cohorts, full trial accounting, or one-use chronological holdout. Its theoretical assumptions and convergence statements do not transfer to Zenith.

sources.mapping: CP1/CP2 form the candidate forward computation; diagnosis and reflection are critic/search context; native frozen cohort scoring is the external evaluator. The mapping is conceptual, not an implementation of the paper.
adopt: Separate inexpensive critique from measured market outcomes.
Retain failures and successes, their scores, and source identity.
Keep the forward predictor small and learning outside a frozen prediction episode.
defer_or_reject: Do not equate an LLM judge score with realized predictive improvement.
Do not introduce arbitrary generated-factor execution or automatic knowledge-base mutation merely to reproduce the framework.

paper.acquisition: ai_workflow tools/meta/annex/arxiv_api.py fetch --tex-only; no paper code executed

sources.paper_mechanism: Fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts provide reports. Bull/bear researchers debate; a research manager plans; a trader proposes action; risk roles debate; a fund manager decides. Structured reports and shared state connect roles.

paper_evaluation.window: 2024-01-01 through 2024-03-29; result table reports AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN.
paper_evaluation.boundary: Three-month trading simulation is not our target-price-loss experiment. No detailed commission or slippage model was located in the inspected experimental sections. Published return claims are not Zenith results.

sources.current_code_mechanism: Settlement waits for a complete configured holding window, calculates stock close return and benchmark-relative alpha, and records a resolution date. A separate LLM produces a short reflection. Historical lesson lookup admits only resolved outcomes dated on or before as_of. The backtest runs independent ticker/date cells and reports rating direction hit rate and mean alpha; it explicitly is not a portfolio simulator and labels unarchived text-feed results indicative rather than repeatable.
sources.mapping: Source reports correspond to admitted evidence and CP1 synthesis; the final decision corresponds only loosely to CP2 forecasts. Dated outcome reflection resembles our outer diagnosis, but memory injection is not a frozen single-variable candidate experiment.
adopt: Keep factual source reports separate from final synthesis.
Require outcome-resolution dates before lessons enter a later prediction context.
State whether evaluation measures independent decisions or a filled portfolio.
defer_or_reject: Defer full bull/bear and risk debate until a paired ablation justifies extra calls.
Do not use evolving shared reflection memory as an unrecorded intervention between model arms.
Do not convert our forecast error into the paper trading returns.
sources.version_boundary: The pinned repository is a current implementation snapshot, not a claim to reconstruct the paper v7 experiment.

sources.paper_mechanism: Price-only indicators, chart patterns and fitted trend channels feed risk and decision reasoning. The final action is forced LONG or SHORT over the next three candles, with fixed stop loss and LLM-selected reward ratio.

paper_evaluation.data: 1-hour and 4-hour bars; 5,000 bars per asset, 100 randomly sampled 100-candle segments per asset, final three candles withheld from inference.
paper_evaluation.boundary: Random segment evaluation is different from a chronological development/holdout cohort. The stated hourly intervals and admitted LLM/tool latency do not establish market-microstructure high-frequency execution. Trading simulations are not point-price-error evaluation.

sources.current_code_mechanism: StateGraph has serial Indicator, Pattern, Trend, DecisionMaker nodes. The final prompt prohibits HOLD and mixes an example N=1 with a next-three-candle output horizon. Tool/model wrappers can retry, and nodes can make several calls. The read forward graph is not a candidate-parameter or topology-learning loop.
sources.mapping: Closest price-only forward graph. Zenith can retain deterministic feature calculation followed by one evidence summary and one typed forecast without adopting three extra specialist model stages.
adopt: Compute numerical price features deterministically before language reasoning.
Make the analytical inputs and requested forecast horizon explicit.
defer_or_reject: Defer vision charts and specialist ensembles until measured benefit covers their cost.
Do not copy inconsistent horizon prompts, forced trade positions, or retry behavior into the strict native budget/forecast contract.
sources.version_boundary: Use QuantHarness for v4/current code and QuantAgent only when explicitly naming the 2025 v1; neither is Wang et al. 2024.

sources.paper_mechanism: Financial CoT decomposes financial tasks. Four platform layers provide agents, LLM algorithms, LLMOps/DataOps, and model access. A Market Forecaster combines company overview, prices, news, and financials for a coming-week forecast; another application produces financial reports.

paper_evaluation.task: Market forecasting and financial document analysis/report generation demos.
paper_evaluation.boundary: The inspected v2 paper presents qualitative examples and a tutorial rather than a controlled comparative trading backtest for the current strategy-selection module.

sources.current_code_mechanism: A typed LLM selects a strategy configuration. Up to three deterministic BackTrader in-sample runs feed quantitative summaries to an adjustment agent. The best available annualized-return score selects parameters for one out-of-sample tail run. The normal split is 70/30 calendar time, requiring a 60-day tail; its split endpoints share a boundary date. Short windows return explicitly warned in-sample results. Model failure can fall back to default SMA. The adapter explicitly assumes zero commission and zero slippage.
sources.mapping: Closest inspected executable parameter-change/backtest loop. Its strategy parameters and return objective differ from our skill text and target-price loss, but the propose/evaluate/select/heldout separation is directly relevant.
adopt: Use typed, bounded candidate changes and quantitative evaluation feedback.
Choose candidates on development data and report a separate final assessment.
Pin immutable ticker, date, source, model and evaluator fields outside LLM discretion.
defer_or_reject: Do not adopt automatic fallback, warned same-window tuning, or an overlapping split boundary as our heldout contract.
Do not interpret zero-cost simulated returns as executable profitability.
Defer the broad platform, desktop and portfolio simulator; reuse our native executor and cohort instead.
sources.version_boundary: The current code provides this optimization example. The 2024 v2 paper does not establish that later module or its effectiveness.

recommended_minimal_structure.implementation: Deterministic point-in-time price features and explicit unavailable sources.
One CP1 evidence/thesis skill, retaining citation and native schema contracts.
One CP2 exact-horizon point forecast skill; no implicit filled trade.
External dated truth and complete paired cohort loss, with pending and failures retained.
Development-only diagnosis plus bounded verified trace context proposes one reviewed change.
Freeze the new candidate and run the same evaluator; final holdout is separately sealed. Additional agents require explicit ablations.

claim_boundaries: Architecture similarity and attribution do not establish novel learning, better forecasts, causal diagnosis or profitable trading.
Textual/discrete candidate search changes skill instructions; it is not numerical backpropagation through market outcomes.
Lean contract-composition and acyclicity proofs do not prove empirical forecasting skill or profit.
Historical source cutoffs do not by themselves eliminate foundation-model training contamination.
This document makes no changes to runtime, providers, budget ledgers or failed-run artifacts.
